T: Do you remember the taste of strawberries. Here they are.
D: The final battle for Middle-earth as Frodo and Sam make the last climb up Mount Doom.
P: Serve the drinks when the hobbits are back at the pub in the Shire.
S: Thyme butter drumsticks with cherry tomatoes, red grapes and crusty bread
Roast chicken drumsticks, cherry tomatoes that burst when you bite them, red grapes and crusty bread, eaten slowly on a long table.
Sugared strawberries layered with honey whipped cream and shortbread crumbs

Ripe strawberries macerated with sugar and lemon, piled with honey-sweetened whipped cream and crumbled butter shortbread for crunch. Halve 500g strawberries and toss with 2 tbsp caster sugar and a squeeze of lemon, then leave 20 minutes until juicy. Whip 300ml cream with 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp vanilla to soft peaks. Roughly crumble 8 butter shortbread biscuits. Layer the strawberries and their juice, cream and shortbread in 4 glasses or bowls and finish with a few whole berries.
Minas Tirith garlic and herb flatbreads
the white city on the mountain

Soft yeasted flatbreads blistered in a smoking pan, brushed with garlic, parsley and thyme butter, with a bowl of whipped feta and honey. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 250ml warm water and 2 tbsp olive oil and knead 8 minutes, then prove 1 hour. Divide into 8, roll thin and cook in a smoking dry pan for 1 to 2 minutes a side until blistered. Melt 60g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, parsley and thyme and brush over. Blend 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt, then drizzle with honey.
M: Red wine gravy, roast potatoes and honey-roasted carrots and parsnips
Beef sirloin roasted at 200C to 52C, rested, carved, with roast potatoes, honey-glazed carrots and parsnips, and a red wine gravy.
Green Dragon chicken and leek pie
home in the Shire at the end

Chicken thigh, leek and mushroom in a creamy thyme sauce under a golden puff pastry lid, with buttery mash and minted peas. Brown 1kg diced chicken thighs in butter, then add 2 sliced leeks and 250g sliced mushrooms and cook 6 minutes. Stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, then 400ml chicken stock and 150ml cream, add thyme and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Cool slightly, tip into a pie dish, top with puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Serve with mash and peas tossed with butter and mint.
W: Fruit and almond cake filled with apricot jam under white icing
Light fruit cake with almonds, layered with apricot jam, covered in white icing, small flowers on top.
K: Green Dragon honey and ginger ale cup
English bitter or pale ale over honey ginger syrup and lemon, ginger beer if you prefer

English bitter stirred with a fresh honey ginger syrup and lemon, poured into pint glasses over a little ice, a lemon wheel on top. Simmer 100g honey, 100ml water and a thumb of sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. Put 2 tbsp syrup and a squeeze of lemon in each of 4 pint glasses, add a few ice cubes and pour in a 375ml bottle of English bitter or pale ale, tilting the glass. Stir once and add a lemon wheel. Use ginger beer for the non-drinkers.

s.note: Thyme butter drumsticks with cherry tomatoes, red grapes and crusty bread
s.how: Rub 8 chicken drumsticks with butter, thyme and salt and roast at 200C for 40 minutes. Lay on a long board with 250g cherry tomatoes, red grapes and torn crusty bread. Eat slowly.

s.note: Sugared strawberries layered with honey whipped cream and shortbread crumbs
s.how: Halve 500g strawberries and toss with 2 tbsp caster sugar and a squeeze of lemon, then leave 20 minutes until juicy. Whip 300ml cream with 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp vanilla to soft peaks. Roughly crumble 8 butter shortbread biscuits. Layer the strawberries and their juice, cream and shortbread in 4 glasses or bowls and finish with a few whole berries.

m.note: Red wine gravy, roast potatoes and honey-roasted carrots and parsnips
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg sirloin at 200C to 52C and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes. Toss 3 carrots and 3 parsnips with honey and roast for 35 minutes. Reduce 200ml red wine with the pan juices for gravy.

w.note: Fruit and almond cake filled with apricot jam under white icing
w.how: Beat 175g butter and 175g brown sugar, add 3 eggs, then fold in 225g self-raising flour, 300g mixed dried fruit and 50g almonds. Bake at 160C for 90 minutes. Split, fill with apricot jam and cover in 300g white icing with small flowers.
